snippet.title: Wild Draw - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Play cards. Screw over your friends. Then shoot it out. WILD DRAW is a first-person party game for 3–6 players where every round starts at the saloon table and ends in chaos.

Coming to Steam on 19th of October!

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5328190/Wild_Draw
